title: The dynamic obstruction is conjecture-conditional and outside read-once scope
statement: Under preprocessed OuMv hypothesis H, the supplied self-contained reduction rules out a general bounded-fan-in SHARED Boolean circuit algorithm with polynomial preprocessing and BOTH updateO(N^(1/2-epsilon)) and fixed-mean queryO(N^(1-epsilon)), absolute error<=1/8,joint success>=2/3. Majority replicas keep independent primitive biases in[1/4,3/4],and output mixing keeps queried means in[1/4,3/4]. The reduction pays local updates and simultaneous success/amplification assumptions; H is unproved. Ordinary retained row counts give O(n) v-bit updates,O(1) u-bit/query work on its Boolean matrix family and match the exponent; full resimulation is a weak comparator. This is not an unconditional lower bound,not every matrix/trajectory,not a constraint on the read-once positive compiler or bounded-treewidth reuse.

At the nonvanishing local-effect fixture, the ordinary preselected-pair method used135 observations; forcing a4100-coordinate initial cache gave4233 total observations and4097 initial gates. The135 count is one realized run, not a universal expected-cost bound.

General shared-circuit conditional obstruction concerns simultaneously updateO(N^(1/2-epsilon)) and queryO(N^(1-epsilon)) under H, with polynomial preprocessing, error<=1/8 and joint success>=2/3. Ordinary retained row counts already match the relevant lower-bound exponent on that constructed family.
